translations.literal: The people of Xiang loved him as parents; when there were fights and lawsuits, they passed word urging one another to stop, saying: "Do not trouble our Attendant."
translations.idiomatic: The people of Xiang loved him as parents. When there were fights and lawsuits, they passed word urging one another to stop, saying, "Do not trouble our Attendant."

sentences.zh: 與富弼齊名，號稱賢相，人謂之「富韓」云。

translations.literal: He was famed equally with Fu Bi, called worthy chief councillors; people called them "Fu and Han."
translations.idiomatic: He was famed equally with Fu Bi and called a worthy chief councillor. People called them "Fu and Han."

sentences.zh: 徽宗追論琦定策勳，贈魏郡王。

translations.literal: Huizong posthumously reviewed Qi's merit in settling policy and enfeoffed him as Prince of Wei commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Huizong posthumously reviewed Han Qi's merit in settling the succession and enfeoffed him as Prince of Wei commandery.

sentences.zh: 子五人：忠彥、端彥、純彥、粹彥、嘉彥。

translations.literal: He had five sons: Zhongyan, Duanyan, Chunyan, Cuiyan, and Jiayan.
translations.idiomatic: He had five sons: Zhongyan, Duanyan, Chunyan, Cuiyan, and Jiayan.

sentences.zh: 端彥右贊善大夫。

translations.literal: Duanyan was Right Gentleman for Fostering Goodness.
translations.idiomatic: Duanyan was Right Gentleman for Fostering Goodness.

sentences.zh: 純彥官至徽猷閣直學士。

translations.literal: Chunyan reached the post of Academician on Special Duty in the Hall of Splendid Culture.
translations.idiomatic: Chunyan reached the post of Academician on Special Duty in the Hall of Splendid Culture.

sentences.zh: 粹彥為吏部侍郎，終龍圖閣學士。

translations.literal: Cuiyan was Vice Minister of Personnel and ended as Academician of the Dragon Diagram Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Cuiyan was Vice Minister of Personnel and ended as Academician of the Dragon Diagram Hall.

sentences.zh: 嘉彥尚神宗女齊國公主，拜駙馬都尉，終瀛海軍承宣使。

translations.literal: Jiayan married Shenzong's daughter, the Princess of Qi, was appointed Commandant of the Imperial Son-in-Law's Household, and ended as Commissioner-in-Chief of the Yinghai army.
translations.idiomatic: Jiayan married Shenzong's daughter, the Princess of Qi, was appointed Commandant of the Imperial Son-in-Law's Household, and ended as Commissioner-in-Chief of the Yinghai army.

sentences.zh: 子 忠彥

translations.literal: Son: Zhongyan
translations.idiomatic: Son: Zhongyan

sentences.zh: 忠彥，字師樸，少以父任，為將作監簿，復舉進士。

translations.literal: Zhongyan, courtesy name Shipu, in youth entered office through his father's privilege as Registrar of the Directorate for Palace Buildings, and again passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongyan, whose courtesy name was Shipu, in youth entered office through his father's privilege as Registrar of the Directorate for Palace Buildings, and again passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 琦罷政，忠彥以秘書丞召試館職，除校理、同知太常禮院，為開封府判官、三司鹽鐵判官。

translations.literal: When Qi left office, Zhongyan was summoned as Secretary of the Secretariat to test for a library post, appointed Collator and Associate Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and served as investigating officer of Kaifeng prefecture and salt-and-iron reviewer in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: When Han Qi left office, Zhongyan was summoned as Secretary of the Secretariat to test for a library post, appointed Collator and Associate Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and served as investigating officer of Kaifeng prefecture and salt-and-iron reviewer in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 出通判永寧軍，召還，為戶部判官。

translations.literal: He went out as vice prefect of the Yongning army, was recalled, and became fiscal reviewer in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He went out as vice prefect of the Yongning army, was recalled, and became fiscal reviewer in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 使還。

translations.literal: He returned from his mission.
translations.idiomatic: He returned from his mission.

sentences.zh: 時官制行，章惇為門下侍郎，奏：「給事中，東省屬官，封駁宜先稟而後上。」

translations.literal: At the time the official system was implemented. Zhang Dun was Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and memorialized: "The Supervising Secretary is an official of the Eastern Department; review and rejection should first be reported and only then submitted upward."
translations.idiomatic: At the time the official system was implemented. Zhang Dun was Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and memorialized, "The Supervising Secretary is an official of the Eastern Department. Review and rejection should first be reported and only then submitted upward."

sentences.zh: 忠彥奏：「朝廷之事，執政之所行也。

translations.literal: Zhongyan memorialized: "Affairs of the court are what the chief administrators carry out.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongyan memorialized, "Affairs of the court are what the chief administrators carry out.

sentences.zh: 事當封駁，則與執政固已異矣，尚何稟議之有。」

translations.literal: When a matter should be reviewed and rejected, it is already at odds with the chief administrators—what need is there for prior consultation?"
translations.idiomatic: When a matter should be reviewed and rejected, it is already at odds with the chief administrators. What need is there for prior consultation?"

sentences.zh: 詔從其請。

translations.literal: An edict followed his request.
translations.idiomatic: An edict followed his request.

sentences.zh: 左僕射王珪為南郊大禮使，事之當下者，自從其所畫旨。

translations.literal: Left Vice Director Wang Gui was Grand Ritual Commissioner for the Southern Suburb; matters that should be issued he handled according to his own drafted instructions.
translations.idiomatic: Left Vice Director Wang Gui was Grand Ritual Commissioner for the Southern Suburb. Matters that should be issued he handled according to his own drafted instructions.

sentences.zh: 忠彥以官制駁之曰：「今事於南郊者，大禮使既不從中畫旨，處分出一時者，又不從中書奏審。

translations.literal: Zhongyan rejected this on grounds of the official system, saying: "Now in matters of the Southern Suburb, the Grand Ritual Commissioner neither follows central drafted instructions, nor do urgent dispositions go through the Secretariat for memorial review.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongyan rejected this on grounds of the official system, saying, "Now in matters of the Southern Suburb, the Grand Ritual Commissioner neither follows central drafted instructions, nor do urgent dispositions go through the Secretariat for memorial review.

sentences.zh: 官制之行，曾未期月，而廟堂自渝之，後將若之何？」

translations.literal: The official system has not yet been in force a full month, yet the court itself violates it—what will be done afterward?"
translations.idiomatic: The official system has not yet been in force a full month, yet the court itself violates it. What will be done afterward?"

sentences.zh: 乃詔事無鉅細，必經三省而後行。

translations.literal: An edict was then issued that matters great and small must pass through the Three Departments before being carried out.
translations.idiomatic: An edict was then issued that matters great and small must pass through the Three Departments before being carried out.

sentences.zh: 拜禮部尚書，以樞密直學士知定州。

translations.literal: He was appointed Minister of Rites and, as Academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs, served as prefect of Dingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Minister of Rites and, as Academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs, served as prefect of Dingzhou.

sentences.zh: 進左僕射兼門下侍郎，封儀國公。

translations.literal: He was advanced to Left Vice Director and concurrent Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, and enfeoffed as Duke of Yi.
translations.idiomatic: He was advanced to Left Vice Director and concurrent Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, and enfeoffed as Duke of Yi.

sentences.zh: 而曾布為右相，多不協，言事者助布排忠彥，以觀文殿大學士知大名府。

translations.literal: But Zeng Bu was the right chief councillor and they were often at odds; memorialists helped Bu drive out Zhongyan, who was made Grand Academician of the Hall for Observing Culture and prefect of Daming.
translations.idiomatic: But Zeng Bu was the right chief councillor and they were often at odds. Memorialists helped Bu drive out Zhongyan, who was made Grand Academician of the Hall for Observing Culture and prefect of Daming.

sentences.zh: 又以欽聖欲復廢后，為忠彥罪，再降太中大夫，懷州居住。

translations.literal: Also because Empress Qinsheng wished to restore the deposed empress, Zhongyan was charged, demoted again to Grandee of Palace Attendance, and made to reside in Huaizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Also because Empress Qinsheng wished to restore the deposed empress, Zhongyan was charged, demoted again to Grandee of Palace Attendance, and made to reside in Huaizhou.

sentences.zh: 又論忠彥在相位，不應棄湟州，謫崇信軍節度副使，濟州居住。

translations.literal: It was further argued that while Zhongyan was chief councillor he should not have abandoned Huangzhou; he was demoted to Vice Military Commissioner of the Chongxin army and made to reside in Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: It was further argued that while Zhongyan was chief councillor he should not have abandoned Huangzhou. He was demoted to Vice Military Commissioner of the Chongxin army and made to reside in Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 逮復湟、鄯，又謫磁州團練副使。

translations.literal: When Huang and Shan were recovered, he was again demoted to Vice Commissioner-in-Chief of the Cizhou army.
translations.idiomatic: When Huang and Shan were recovered, he was again demoted to Vice Commissioner-in-Chief of the Cizhou army.

sentences.zh: 復太中大夫，遂以宣奉大夫致仕。

translations.literal: Restored to Grandee of Palace Attendance, he then retired as Grandee for Court Audience.
translations.idiomatic: Restored to Grandee of Palace Attendance, he then retired as Grandee for Court Audience.

sentences.zh: 卒，年七十二。

translations.literal: He died, aged seventy-two.
translations.idiomatic: He died, aged seventy-two.

sentences.zh: 子治，徽宗時，為太僕少卿，出知相州。

translations.literal: His son Zhi, in Huizong's time, was Vice Minister of the Imperial Stud and went out as prefect of Xiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zhi, in Huizong's time, was Vice Minister of the Imperial Stud and went out as prefect of Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 以疾丐祠，命其子肖胄代之，別有傳。

translations.literal: Because of illness he requested a temple post; his son Xiaozhou was ordered to replace him—he has a separate biography.
translations.idiomatic: Because of illness he requested a temple post. His son Xiaozhou was ordered to replace him. He has a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 論曰：琦相三朝，立二帝，厥功大矣。

translations.literal: The commentary says: Qi was chief councillor through three reigns and established two emperors—his achievement was great.
translations.idiomatic: The commentary says: Han Qi was chief councillor through three reigns and established two emperors. His achievement was great.

sentences.zh: 當治平危疑之際，兩宮幾成嫌隙，琦處之裕如，卒安社稷，人服其量。

translations.literal: At the perilous and doubtful moment of Zhiping, the two palaces nearly came to a breach; Qi handled it with ease and in the end settled the altars of state—people submitted to his magnanimity.
translations.idiomatic: At the perilous and doubtful moment of Zhiping, the two palaces nearly came to a breach. Han Qi handled it with ease and in the end settled the altars of state. People submitted to his magnanimity.

sentences.zh: 歐陽修稱其「臨大事，決大議，垂紳正笏，不動聲色，措天下于泰山之安，可謂社稷之臣」。

translations.literal: Ouyang Xiu praised him: "Facing great affairs and deciding great deliberations, with robes hanging straight and tablet held upright, he did not move voice or countenance, and set the realm in the security of Mount Tai—he may be called a minister of the altars of state."
translations.idiomatic: Ouyang Xiu praised him: "Facing great affairs and deciding great deliberations, with robes hanging straight and tablet held upright, he did not move voice or countenance, and set the realm in the security of Mount Tai. He may be called a minister of the altars of state."

sentences.zh: 豈不信哉！

translations.literal: Is this not to be believed!
translations.idiomatic: Is this not to be believed!

sentences.zh: 忠彥世濟其美，繼登相位，宜矣。

translations.literal: Zhongyan through generations continued his excellence and in turn ascended the chief councillorship—fitting indeed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongyan through generations continued his excellence and in turn ascended the chief councillorship—fitting indeed.

sentences.zh: 曾公亮

translations.literal: Zeng Gongliang
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Gongliang

sentences.zh: 曾公亮，字明仲，泉州晉江人。

translations.literal: Zeng Gongliang, courtesy name Mingzhong, was a native of Jinjiang in Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Gongliang, whose courtesy name was Mingzhong, was a native of Jinjiang in Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 舉進士甲科，知會稽縣。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination in the first class and served as magistrate of Kuaiji county.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the first class and served as magistrate of Kuaiji county.

sentences.zh: 民田鏡湖旁，每患湖溢。

translations.literal: The people's fields lay beside Mirror Lake, and each year they suffered from the lake overflowing.
translations.idiomatic: The people's fields lay beside Mirror Lake, and each year they suffered from the lake overflowing.

sentences.zh: 公亮立斗門，泄水入曹娥江，民受其利。

translations.literal: Gongliang built sluice gates and discharged water into the Cao'e River; the people received the benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Gongliang built sluice gates and discharged water into the Cao'e River. The people received the benefit.

sentences.zh: 坐父買田境中，謫監湖州酒。

translations.literal: Because his father bought land within the prefectural boundary, he was demoted to supervisor of wine in Huzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Because his father bought land within the prefectural boundary, he was demoted to supervisor of wine in Huzhou.

sentences.zh: 久之，為國子監直講，改諸王府侍講。

translations.literal: After a long time he became Lecturer on Special Duty in the Directorate of Education and was transferred to Lecturer in the Various Princes' Households.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time he became Lecturer on Special Duty in the Directorate of Education and was transferred to Lecturer in the Various Princes' Households.

sentences.zh: 歲滿，當用故事試館職，獨獻所為文，授集賢校理、天章閣侍講、修起居注。

translations.literal: When his term ended he should by precedent have tested for a library post, but he alone submitted writings he had composed and was appointed Collator of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, Lecturer in the Heavenly Manifestation Hall, and Compiler of the Daily Record.
translations.idiomatic: When his term ended he should by precedent have tested for a library post, but he alone submitted writings he had composed and was appointed Collator of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, Lecturer in the Heavenly Manifestation Hall, and Compiler of the Daily Record.

sentences.zh: 擢天章閣待制，賜金紫。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Awaiting Orders in the Heavenly Manifestation Hall and granted gold and purple.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Awaiting Orders in the Heavenly Manifestation Hall and granted gold and purple.

sentences.zh: 先是，待制不改服。

translations.literal: Previously, Awaiting Orders did not change their dress.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, Awaiting Orders did not change their dress.

sentences.zh: 仁宗面錫之，曰：「朕自講席賜卿，所以尊寵儒臣也。」

translations.literal: Renzong personally bestowed it on him and said: "I grant this to you from the lecture seat in order to honor and favor a Confucian minister."
translations.idiomatic: Renzong personally bestowed it on him and said, "I grant this to you from the lecture seat in order to honor and favor a Confucian minister."

sentences.zh: 遂知制誥兼史館修撰，為翰林學士、判三班院。

translations.literal: He was then made drafter of edicts and concurrent Compiler for the History Office, Hanlin academician, and judge of the Three-Rank Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: He was then made drafter of edicts and concurrent Compiler for the History Office, Hanlin academician, and judge of the Three-Rank Bureau.

sentences.zh: 三班吏叢猥，非賕謝不行，貴遊子弟，多倚勢請謁。

translations.literal: The clerks of the Three-Rank Bureau were numerous and disorderly; without bribes and favors nothing could be done, and sons of noble families mostly relied on influence to request audiences.
translations.idiomatic: The clerks of the Three-Rank Bureau were numerous and disorderly. Without bribes and favors nothing could be done, and sons of noble families mostly relied on influence to request audiences.

sentences.zh: 公亮掇前後章程，視以從事，吏不能舉手。

translations.literal: Gongliang gathered former and latter regulations and showed them as the standard for conduct; the clerks could not raise a hand against him.
translations.idiomatic: Gongliang gathered former and latter regulations and showed them as the standard for conduct. The clerks could not raise a hand against him.

sentences.zh: 以端明殿學士知鄭州，為政有能聲，盜悉竄他境，至夜戶不閉。

translations.literal: As Academician of the Hall of Illustrious Brightness he served as prefect of Zhengzhou. His governance had a reputation for ability; bandits all fled to other territories, and at night households did not close their doors.
translations.idiomatic: As Academician of the Hall of Illustrious Brightness he served as prefect of Zhengzhou. His governance had a reputation for ability. Bandits all fled to other territories, and at night households did not close their doors.

sentences.zh: 嘗有使客亡橐中物，移書詰盜，公亮報：「吾境不藏盜，殆從者之廋耳。」

translations.literal: Once an envoy guest lost something from his bag; he sent a letter demanding the thief. Gongliang replied: "My territory does not harbor thieves—perhaps it was hidden by one of your attendants."
translations.idiomatic: Once an envoy guest lost something from his bag and sent a letter demanding the thief. Gongliang replied, "My territory does not harbor thieves. Perhaps it was hidden by one of your attendants."

sentences.zh: 索之，果然。

translations.literal: When they searched, it was indeed so.
translations.idiomatic: When they searched, it was indeed so.

sentences.zh: 復入為翰林學士、知開封府。

translations.literal: He re-entered court as Hanlin academician and prefect of Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: He re-entered court as Hanlin academician and prefect of Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 未幾，擢給事中、參知政事。

translations.literal: Before long he was promoted to Supervising Secretary and Vice Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was promoted to Supervising Secretary and Vice Grand Councillor.

sentences.zh: 加禮部侍郎，除樞密使。

translations.literal: He was given the additional title of Vice Minister of Rites and appointed Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was given the additional title of Vice Minister of Rites and appointed Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 嘉祐六年，拜吏部侍郎、同中書門下平章事、集賢殿大學士。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Jiayou he was appointed Vice Minister of Personnel, Grand Councillor of the Tongzhongshu Menxia type, and Grand Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Jiayou he was appointed Vice Minister of Personnel, Grand Councillor, and Grand Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies.

sentences.zh: 公亮明練文法，更踐久，習知朝廷臺閣典憲，首相韓琦每咨訪焉。

translations.literal: Gongliang was clear and practiced in statutes and regulations; having served long in office, he was thoroughly versed in the court's bureau regulations and precedents, and chief councillor Han Qi often consulted him.
translations.idiomatic: Gongliang was clear and practiced in statutes and regulations. Having served long in office, he was thoroughly versed in the court's bureau regulations and precedents, and chief councillor Han Qi often consulted him.

sentences.zh: 仁宗末年，琦請建儲，與公亮等共定大議。

translations.literal: In the last years of Renzong, Qi requested establishing an heir, and with Gongliang and others jointly settled the great decision.
translations.idiomatic: In the last years of Renzong, Han Qi requested establishing an heir, and with Gongliang and others jointly settled the great decision.

sentences.zh: 密州民田產銀，或盜取之，大理當以強。

translations.literal: In Mizhou the people's fields produced silver, and some stole it; the Court for Imperial Cases judged it as robbery by force.
translations.idiomatic: In Mizhou the people's fields produced silver, and some stole it. The Court for Imperial Cases judged it as robbery by force.

sentences.zh: 公亮曰：「此禁物也，取之雖強，與盜物民家有間矣。」

translations.literal: Gongliang said: "This is a forbidden substance; though taking it was by force, there is a distinction from robbing goods from a common household."
translations.idiomatic: Gongliang said, "This is a forbidden substance. Though taking it was by force, there is a distinction from robbing goods from a common household."

sentences.zh: 固爭之，遂下有司議，比劫禁物法，盜得不死。

translations.literal: He firmly disputed it, and the matter was sent down to the relevant offices for deliberation; by analogy to the law on forbidden substances, theft did not incur death.
translations.idiomatic: He firmly disputed it, and the matter was sent down to the relevant offices for deliberation. By analogy to the law on forbidden substances, theft did not incur death.

sentences.zh: 初，東州人多用此抵法，自是無死者。

translations.literal: At first many in the eastern prefectures used this as a precedent in law; from then on there were no deaths.
translations.idiomatic: At first many in the eastern prefectures used this as a precedent in law. From then on there were no deaths.

sentences.zh: 契丹縱人漁界河，又數通鹽舟，吏不敢禁，皆謂與之校，且生事。

translations.literal: The Khitan allowed their people to fish in the border river and repeatedly sent salt boats through; officials did not dare forbid it, all saying that to contend with them would also create trouble.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan allowed their people to fish in the border river and repeatedly sent salt boats through. Officials did not dare forbid it, all saying that to contend with them would also create trouble.

sentences.zh: 公亮言：「萌芽不禁，後將奈何？

translations.literal: Gongliang said: "If the sprout is not forbidden, what will be done later?
translations.idiomatic: Gongliang said, "If the sprout is not forbidden, what will be done later?

sentences.zh: 雄州趙滋勇而有謀，可任也。」

translations.literal: Zhao Zi of Xiongzhou is brave and has plans—he can be entrusted."
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Zi of Xiongzhou is brave and has plans. He can be entrusted."

sentences.zh: 使諭以指意，邊害訖息。

translations.literal: He was sent to convey the intended meaning, and frontier harm ceased entirely.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent to convey the intended meaning, and frontier harm ceased entirely.

sentences.zh: 英宗即位，加中書侍郎兼禮部尚書，尋加戶部尚書。

translations.literal: When Yingzong took the throne, Gongliang was given the additional titles of Vice Director of the Secretariat and Minister of Rites, and soon Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: When Yingzong took the throne, Gongliang was given the additional titles of Vice Director of the Secretariat and Minister of Rites, and soon Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 帝不豫，遼使至不能見，命公亮宴于館，使者不肯赴，公亮質之曰：「錫宴不赴，是不虔君命也。

translations.literal: The emperor was unwell; when Liao envoys arrived they could not be received, and Gongliang was ordered to host a banquet at the lodge. The envoys refused to attend. Gongliang questioned them, saying: "To refuse a granted banquet is to be irreverent toward the sovereign's command.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was unwell. When Liao envoys arrived they could not be received, and Gongliang was ordered to host a banquet at the lodge. The envoys refused to attend. Gongliang questioned them, saying, "To refuse a granted banquet is to be irreverent toward the sovereign's command.

sentences.zh: 人主有疾，而必使親臨，處之安乎？」

translations.literal: The ruler is ill—must he personally attend? Is that a proper way to handle it?"
translations.idiomatic: The ruler is ill. Must he personally attend? Is that a proper way to handle it?"

sentences.zh: 使者即就席。

translations.literal: The envoys thereupon took their seats.
translations.idiomatic: The envoys thereupon took their seats.

sentences.zh: 神宗即位，加門下侍郎兼吏部尚書。

translations.literal: When Shenzong took the throne, he was given the additional titles of Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: When Shenzong took the throne, he was given the additional titles of Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 公亮方厚莊重，沈深周密，平居謹繩墨，蹈規矩；

translations.literal: Gongliang was square, thick, solemn, and weighty, deep and thorough in his carefulness; in ordinary life he strictly observed the measuring cord and followed the compass;
translations.idiomatic: Gongliang was square, thick, solemn, and weighty, deep and thorough in his carefulness. In ordinary life he strictly observed the measuring cord and followed the compass;

sentences.zh: 然性吝嗇，殖貨至鉅萬，帝嘗以方張安世。

translations.literal: yet by nature he was stingy and amassed goods to the amount of tens of thousands; the emperor once compared him to Zhang Anshi.
translations.idiomatic: yet by nature he was stingy and amassed goods to the amount of tens of thousands. The emperor once compared him to Zhang Anshi.

sentences.zh: 初薦王安石，及同輔政，知上方向之，陰為子孫計，凡更張庶事，一切聽順，而外若不與之者。

translations.literal: He at first recommended Wang Anshi, and when they jointly assisted in government, knowing the emperor's direction favored him, he secretly planned for his descendants; in all broad reforms of various affairs he entirely listened and assented, while outwardly seeming not to join in.
translations.idiomatic: He at first recommended Wang Anshi, and when they jointly assisted in government, knowing the emperor favored him, he secretly planned for his descendants. In all broad reforms of various affairs he entirely listened and assented, while outwardly seeming not to join in.

sentences.zh: 嘗遣子孝寬參其謀，至上前略無所異，於是帝益信任安石。

translations.literal: He once sent his son Xiaokuan to take part in his plans; before the throne he showed scarcely any difference, and thereby the emperor trusted Anshi all the more.
translations.idiomatic: He once sent his son Xiaokuan to take part in his plans. Before the throne he showed scarcely any difference, and thereby the emperor trusted Wang Anshi all the more.

sentences.zh: 安石德其助己，故引擢孝寬至樞密以報之。

translations.literal: Anshi was grateful for his help and therefore promoted Xiaokuan to the Bureau of Military Affairs in return.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi was grateful for his help and therefore promoted Xiaokuan to the Bureau of Military Affairs in return.

sentences.zh: 蘇軾嘗從容責公亮不能救正，公亮曰：「上與介甫如一人，此乃天也。」

translations.literal: Su Shi once calmly reproached Gongliang for being unable to correct matters. Gongliang said: "The emperor and Jiefu are like one person—this is Heaven's doing."
translations.idiomatic: Su Shi once calmly reproached Gongliang for being unable to correct matters. Gongliang said, "The emperor and Jiefu are like one person. This is Heaven's doing."

sentences.zh: 世譏其持祿固寵云。

translations.literal: The age mocked him for holding his salary and securing favor.
translations.idiomatic: The age mocked him for holding his salary and securing favor.

sentences.zh: 子孝寬，從子孝廣、孝蘊。

translations.literal: His sons were Xiaokuan; his nephews Xiaoguang and Xiaoyun.
translations.idiomatic: His sons were Xiaokuan; his nephews Xiaoguang and Xiaoyun.

sentences.zh: 子 孝寬

translations.literal: Son: Xiaokuan
translations.idiomatic: Son: Xiaokuan

sentences.zh: 孝寬，字令綽，以蔭知桐城縣。

translations.literal: Xiaokuan, courtesy name Lingchuo, entered office as magistrate of Tongcheng County by hereditary privilege.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaokuan, whose courtesy name was Lingchuo, took office as magistrate of Tongcheng County through hereditary privilege.

sentences.zh: 選知咸平縣，民詣府訴雨傷麥，府以妄杖之。

translations.literal: Selected as magistrate of Xianping County. When the people went to the prefectural office to report rain damage to wheat, the office treated it as false and had them beaten with staves.
translations.idiomatic: He was selected as magistrate of Xianping County. When the people went to the prefectural office to report rain damage to their wheat crop, the office dismissed it as false and had them beaten.

sentences.zh: 孝寬躬行田，辨其實，得蠲賦。

translations.literal: Xiaokuan personally walked the fields and verified the facts, obtaining a remission of taxes.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaokuan personally inspected the fields, verified the facts, and obtained a remission of taxes.

sentences.zh: 除秘閣修撰、提點開封府界鎮縣。

translations.literal: Appointed Compiler at the Imperial Library and Intendant of market towns and counties on the boundaries of the Kaifeng metropolitan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Compiler at the Imperial Library and Intendant of market towns and counties on the boundaries of the Kaifeng metropolitan prefecture.

sentences.zh: 保甲法行，民相驚言且籍為兵。

translations.literal: When the baojia system was implemented, the people alarmed one another, saying they would soon be registered as soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: When the baojia system was implemented, the people alarmed one another with talk that they would soon be registered as soldiers.

sentences.zh: 知府韓維上言，乞候農隙行之。

translations.literal: Prefect Han Wei memorialized, asking that it be implemented during agricultural slack season.
translations.idiomatic: The prefect Han Wei memorialized, asking that it be carried out during the agricultural off-season.

sentences.zh: 孝寬牓十七縣，揭賞告捕扇惑者，民兵不敢訴，維之言不得行。

translations.literal: Xiaokuan posted notices in the seventeen counties offering rewards to inform and capture those who stirred up alarm. The militia did not dare complain, and Wei's proposal could not be carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaokuan posted notices in all seventeen counties offering rewards to inform on and capture those who stirred up alarm. The militia did not dare complain, and Wei's proposal could not be implemented.

sentences.zh: 入知審官東院、判刑部。

translations.literal: He entered the capital to serve as Director of the Eastern Court of Judicial Review and Vice Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: He entered the capital to serve as Director of the Eastern Court of Judicial Review and Vice Minister of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 熙寧五年，遷樞密都承旨，承旨用文臣，自孝寬始。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Xining he was transferred to Chief Bearer of the Bureau of Military Affairs. The use of a civil official as chief bearer began with Xiaokuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Xining he was transferred to Chief Bearer of the Bureau of Military Affairs. The appointment of a civil official to that post began with Xiaokuan.

sentences.zh: 擢拜樞密直學士、簽書樞密院。

translations.literal: He was promoted and appointed Academician Directly Attached to the Bureau of Military Affairs and Concurrent Clerk of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted and appointed Academician Directly Attached to the Bureau of Military Affairs and Concurrent Clerk of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 丁父憂，除喪，以端明殿學士知河陽，徙鄆。

translations.literal: When his father died he observed mourning. After the mourning period ended he was made Academician of the Hall of Lucid Talents and prefect of Heyang, then transferred to Yan.
translations.idiomatic: When his father died he entered mourning. After the mourning period he was made Academician of the Hall of Lucid Talents and prefect of Heyang, then transferred to Yan.

sentences.zh: 鄆有孟子廟，孝寬請於朝，得封鄒國公，配享孔子。

translations.literal: Yan had a temple to Mencius. Xiaokuan petitioned the court and obtained enfeoffment of Mencius as Duke of Zou, with a place in the sacrificial rites alongside Confucius.
translations.idiomatic: Yan had a temple to Mencius. Xiaokuan petitioned the court and obtained enfeoffment of Mencius as Duke of Zou, with a place in the sacrificial rites alongside Confucius.

sentences.zh: 連徙鎮，以吏部尚書召，道卒，年六十六。

translations.literal: After successive transfers as military commissioner, he was summoned as Minister of Personnel but died on the road, aged sixty-six.
translations.idiomatic: After successive transfers as military commissioner, he was summoned as Minister of Personnel but died on the road, aged sixty-six.

sentences.zh: 贈右光祿大夫。

translations.literal: Posthumously awarded Right Grandee of Splendid Happiness.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously awarded the title Right Grandee of Splendid Happiness.

sentences.zh: 孝廣，字仲錫。

translations.literal: Xiaoguang, courtesy name Zhongxi.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaoguang, whose courtesy name was Zhongxi.

sentences.zh: 元豐末，為北外都水丞。

translations.literal: At the end of the Yuanfeng era he served as Vice Director of the Outer Northern Office of the Waterways.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Yuanfeng era he served as Vice Director of the Outer Northern Office of the Waterways.

sentences.zh: 元祐中，大臣議復河故道，召孝廣問之，言不可，出通判保州。

translations.literal: During the Yuanyou era, the high ministers discussed restoring the old course of the Yellow River and summoned Xiaoguang to question him. He said it could not be done and was sent out as vice prefect of Bao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yuanyou era, the high ministers discussed restoring the Yellow River to its old course and summoned Xiaoguang to consult him. He said it could not be done and was sent out as vice prefect of Bao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 久之，復為都水丞。

translations.literal: After a long while he again served as Vice Director of the Waterways.
translations.idiomatic: After a long interval he again served as Vice Director of the Waterways.

sentences.zh: 前此，班行使臣部木筏至者，須校驗無所失亡，乃得送銓，監吏領賕謝，不時遣。

translations.literal: Before this, when envoys on regular missions arrived escorting timber rafts, they had to be verified as having suffered no loss before they could be forwarded to the Ministry of Personnel for appointment processing. The supervising clerks took bribes and did not dispatch them promptly.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, when envoys on regular missions arrived escorting timber rafts, the rafts had to be verified as having suffered no loss before the envoys could be forwarded to the Ministry of Personnel for appointment processing. The supervising clerks accepted bribes and did not dispatch them promptly.

sentences.zh: 孝廣治籍疏姓名，謹其去留，一歲中，歸選者百輩。

translations.literal: Xiaoguang organized the registers and detailed the names, carefully tracking who came and went. Within one year, a hundred cohorts returned for selection.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaoguang organized the registers, listed the names in detail, and carefully tracked arrivals and departures. Within one year, a hundred groups returned for appointment selection.

sentences.zh: 除京西轉運判官，入為水部員外郎。

translations.literal: Appointed Fiscal Commissioner of the Jingxi Circuit, then entered the capital as Vice Director of the Waterways Bureau in the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Fiscal Commissioner of the Jingxi Circuit, then entered the capital as Vice Director of the Waterways Bureau in the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 河決內黃，詔孝廣行視，遂疏蘇村，鑿鉅野，導河北流，紓澶、滑、深、瀛之害。

translations.literal: The Yellow River burst at Neihuang. An edict ordered Xiaoguang to inspect on site. He then dredged Sucun, cut through Juye, and directed the northern flow of the Yellow River, relieving the damage to Chan, Hua, Shen, and Ying.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River burst its banks at Neihuang. An edict ordered Xiaoguang to inspect the site. He dredged Sucun, cut through Juye, and directed the northern flow of the Yellow River, relieving the flooding in Chan, Hua, Shen, and Ying.

sentences.zh: 遷都水使者。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Commissioner of the Waterways.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Commissioner of the Waterways.

sentences.zh: 洛水頻歲湓湧，浸齧北岸，孝廣按河堤，得廢澾口遺跡，曰：「此昔人所以殺水勢也。」

translations.literal: The Luo River overflowed year after year, eating away at the north bank. Xiaoguang inspected the river dikes and found traces of an abandoned flood gate. He said: "This is how men of old reduced the force of the water."
translations.idiomatic: The Luo River overflowed year after year, eroding the north bank. Xiaoguang inspected the river dikes and found traces of an abandoned sluice. He said, "This is how men of old reduced the force of the water."

sentences.zh: 即日浚決之，累石為防，自是無水患。

translations.literal: That same day he dredged and opened it. He piled stones to form a barrier, and from then on there were no water disasters.
translations.idiomatic: That same day he dredged and opened it, piled stones to form a barrier, and from then on there were no further floods.

sentences.zh: 出提點永興路刑獄，陝西、京西轉運副使，還為左司郎中，擢戶部侍郎，進尚書。

translations.literal: Sent out as Intendant of Legal Affairs for Yongxing Circuit, then Vice Fiscal Commissioner of Shaanxi and Jingxi circuits. He returned to serve as Director of the Left Bureau, was promoted to Vice Minister of Revenue, and advanced to Minister.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent out as Intendant of Legal Affairs for Yongxing Circuit and as Vice Fiscal Commissioner of Shaanxi and Jingxi circuits. He returned to serve as Director of the Left Bureau, was promoted to Vice Minister of Revenue, and then to Minister.

sentences.zh: 坐錢帛不給費，罷為天章閣待制、知杭州。

translations.literal: For failing to supply funds and silk as required, he was dismissed to the post of Academician Awaiting Orders at the Hall of Heavenly Manifestations and prefect of Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Because funds and silk were not supplied as required, he was demoted to Academician Awaiting Orders at the Hall of Heavenly Manifestations and prefect of Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 又以前聘契丹失奉使體，奪職。

translations.literal: Also, for previous failure to observe proper protocol on a mission to the Khitan, his office was stripped.
translations.idiomatic: He was also stripped of rank for earlier failure to observe proper protocol on a mission to the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 尋復之，移知潭州，加顯謨閣直學士、知鄆州。

translations.literal: Soon restored, transferred to prefect of Tanzhou, added Academician Directly Attached to the Hall of Manifest Epigraphy and made prefect of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon restored, transferred to prefect of Tanzhou, and given the additional title of Academician Directly Attached to the Hall of Manifest Epigraphy as prefect of Yan.

sentences.zh: 孝廣與胡安國、鄒浩善，皆大觀中忤時相，御史論之，復奪職知饒州。

translations.literal: Xiaoguang was on good terms with Hu Anguo and Zou Hao. All three offended the chief councillor during the Daguang era. Censors impeached them, and Xiaoguang again lost his office and was made prefect of Raozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaoguang was on good terms with Hu Anguo and Zou Hao. All three offended the chief councillor during the Daguang era. Censors impeached them, and Xiaoguang again lost his office and was made prefect of Raozhou.

sentences.zh: 逾年，徙廣州，歷成德軍、太原府，得故職以卒，年六十，贈正議大夫。

translations.literal: After a year he was transferred to Guangzhou, then served at Chengdé Army and Taiyuan Prefecture. He recovered his former rank and died, aged sixty. Posthumously awarded Grandee of Correct Governing.
translations.idiomatic: After a year he was transferred to Guangzhou, then served at Chengdé Army and Taiyuan Prefecture. He recovered his former rank and died there, aged sixty. He was posthumously awarded the title Grandee of Correct Governing.

sentences.zh: 孝廣涖官以嚴稱，獲盜，輒碎其手焉。

translations.literal: Xiaoguang was known for severity in office. When he captured robbers, he would smash their hands.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaoguang was known for severity in office. Whenever he captured robbers, he would smash their hands.

sentences.zh: 孝蘊，字處善。

translations.literal: Xiaoyun, courtesy name Chushan.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaoyun, whose courtesy name was Chushan.

sentences.zh: 紹聖中，管幹發運司糶糴事，建言揚之瓜洲，潤之京口，常之奔牛，易堰為閘，以便漕運、商賈。

translations.literal: During the Shaosheng era he managed grain sale and purchase affairs of the Transport Commission. He proposed that at Guazhou in Yang Prefecture, Jingkou in Run Prefecture, and Benniu in Chang Prefecture, weirs be converted to sluice gates to facilitate canal transport and merchants.
translations.idiomatic: During the Shaosheng era he managed grain sale and purchase affairs for the Transport Commission. He proposed converting weirs to sluice gates at Guazhou in Yang Prefecture, Jingkou in Run Prefecture, and Benniu in Chang Prefecture to facilitate canal transport and commerce.

sentences.zh: 既成，公私便之。

translations.literal: Once completed, both public and private interests benefited.
translations.idiomatic: Once the work was completed, both the government and private merchants benefited.

sentences.zh: 提舉兩浙常平，改轉運判官，知臨江軍，召為左司員外郎，遷起居舍人。

translations.literal: Intendant of the Changping Granaries of the Two Zhe circuits, then Fiscal Commissioner, prefect of Linjiang Army, summoned as Vice Director of the Left Bureau, promoted to Attendant in the Office of Daily Records.
translations.idiomatic: He served as Intendant of the Changping Granaries of the Two Zhe circuits, then as Fiscal Commissioner and prefect of Linjiang Army. He was summoned as Vice Director of the Left Bureau and promoted to Attendant in the Office of Daily Records.

sentences.zh: 時京邑有盜，徽宗怒，期三日不獲，坐尹罪。

translations.literal: At the time there were robbers in the capital. Emperor Huizong was angry and set a deadline of three days for their capture; failure would mean punishment for the prefectural governor.
translations.idiomatic: At the time there were robbers in the capital. Emperor Huizong was angry and set a three-day deadline for their capture; if they were not caught, the prefect would be punished.

sentences.zh: 孝蘊奏：「求盜急則遁益遠，小緩當自出。」

translations.literal: Xiaoyun memorialized: "If the search for robbers is pressed too urgently, they flee all the farther. A slight easing and they will emerge on their own."
translations.idiomatic: Xiaoyun memorialized, "If the search for robbers is pressed too urgently, they flee all the farther. Ease the pressure slightly and they will emerge on their own."

sentences.zh: 從其言，得盜。

translations.literal: The emperor followed his advice and the robbers were captured.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor followed his advice, and the robbers were captured.

sentences.zh: 崇寧建殿中省，擢為監。

translations.literal: When the Department of Palace Affairs was established in the Chongning era, he was promoted to be its Supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: When the Department of Palace Affairs was established in the Chongning era, he was promoted to serve as its Supervisor.

sentences.zh: 居數月，言者論其與張商英善，以集賢殿修撰出知襄州，徙江浙荊淮發運。

translations.literal: After several months, memorialists criticized his friendship with Zhang Shangying. He was sent out as Compiler at the Hall of Assembled Worthies and prefect of Xiangzhou, then transferred to Transport Commissioner for Jiangsu-Zhejiang and Jing-Huai.
translations.idiomatic: After several months, memorialists criticized his friendship with Zhang Shangying. He was sent out as Compiler at the Hall of Assembled Worthies and prefect of Xiangzhou, then transferred to Transport Commissioner for Jiangsu-Zhejiang and Jing-Huai.

sentences.zh: 泗州議開直河，以避漲溢沙石之害，孝蘊以淮、汴不相接，不可成。

translations.literal: Sizhou proposed opening a straight channel to avoid damage from flooding and sand and gravel buildup. Xiaoyun argued that since the Huai and Bian rivers did not connect, it could not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: Sizhou proposed opening a straight channel to avoid damage from flooding and sand and gravel buildup. Xiaoyun argued that because the Huai and Bian rivers did not connect, the project could not succeed.

sentences.zh: 既而工役大集，竟成之，策勳第賞，辭不受。

translations.literal: Soon a great labor force was assembled and it was completed after all. Ranked for merit and offered reward, he declined to accept.
translations.idiomatic: Soon a great labor force was assembled and the channel was completed after all. When he was ranked for merit and offered a reward, he declined to accept.

sentences.zh: 未幾，河果塞，召為戶部侍郎，帝嘗問右曹儲物幾何，疾作不能對。

translations.literal: Before long the channel indeed silted shut. He was summoned as Vice Minister of Revenue. The emperor once asked how much was stored in the right bureau, but an illness came on and he could not answer.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the channel indeed silted shut. He was summoned as Vice Minister of Revenue. The emperor once asked how much was stored in the right bureau, but he was seized by illness and could not answer.

sentences.zh: 徙工部，以顯謨閣待制知杭州。

translations.literal: Transferred to the Ministry of Works, then made Academician Awaiting Orders at the Hall of Manifest Epigraphy and prefect of Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to the Ministry of Works, then made Academician Awaiting Orders at the Hall of Manifest Epigraphy and prefect of Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 其後坐累，連削黜，至貶安遠軍節度副使。

translations.literal: Afterward he was implicated in successive cases, repeatedly demoted and stripped of rank, until he was banished as Vice Military Commissioner of Anyuan Army.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward he was implicated in successive cases, repeatedly demoted and stripped of rank, until he was banished as Vice Military Commissioner of Anyuan Army.

sentences.zh: 宣和二年，始復天章閣待制、知歙州。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xuanhe he was at last restored as Academician Awaiting Orders at the Hall of Heavenly Manifestations and prefect of She Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xuanhe he was at last restored as Academician Awaiting Orders at the Hall of Heavenly Manifestations and prefect of She Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 方臘起青溪，孝蘊約敕郡內，無得奔擾，分兵守厄塞，有避賊來歸者，獲罪，使出境，人稍恃以安。

translations.literal: When Fang La rose at Qingxi, Xiaoyun issued strict orders within the prefecture forbidding flight and disorder. He divided troops to guard strategic passes. Those who fled the bandits and returned were punished and made to leave the territory. The people gradually relied on this and were somewhat at ease.
translations.idiomatic: When Fang La rose at Qingxi, Xiaoyun issued strict orders within the prefecture forbidding flight and disorder. He divided troops to guard strategic passes. Those who fled the bandits and sought refuge in his jurisdiction were punished and expelled. The people gradually felt somewhat secure.

sentences.zh: 會移青州，既行而歙陷，道改杭州，時賊已破杭，孝蘊單車至城下。

translations.literal: Just as he was transferred to Qing Prefecture, he had already set out when She fell. En route his appointment was changed to Hangzhou. By then the bandits had already taken Hangzhou. Xiaoyun came alone in a single cart to beneath the city walls.
translations.idiomatic: Just as he was transferred to Qing Prefecture, he had already set out when She fell. En route his appointment was changed to Hangzhou. By then the bandits had already taken the city. Xiaoyun came alone in a single cart to the foot of the walls.

sentences.zh: 城既克復，軍士多殺人，孝蘊下令，脅從者得自首，無輒殺，皆束手不敢驁。

translations.literal: Once the city was recovered, the soldiers killed many people. Xiaoyun issued an order that those who had been coerced could surrender themselves, and that no one was to kill indiscriminately. All restrained themselves and did not dare run wild.
translations.idiomatic: Once the city was recovered, the soldiers killed many people. Xiaoyun issued an order that those who had been coerced could surrender themselves and that no one was to kill indiscriminately. All restrained themselves and did not dare run wild.

sentences.zh: 論功，進顯謨閣直學士，又加龍圖閣學士。

translations.literal: For merit he was promoted to Academician Directly Attached to the Hall of Manifest Epigraphy, and further made Academician of the Hall of Dragon Diagrams.
translations.idiomatic: For his merit he was promoted to Academician Directly Attached to the Hall of Manifest Epigraphy, and further made Academician of the Hall of Dragon Diagrams.

sentences.zh: 卒，年六十五，贈通議大夫。

translations.literal: He died, aged sixty-five. Posthumously awarded Grandee of Discussion and Governance.
translations.idiomatic: He died, aged sixty-five. He was posthumously awarded the title Grandee of Discussion and Governance.

sentences.zh: 陳升之

translations.literal: Chen Shengzhi
translations.idiomatic: Chen Shengzhi

sentences.zh: 陳升之，字暘叔，建州建陽人。

translations.literal: Chen Shengzhi, courtesy name Yangshu, was a native of Jianyang in Jian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Shengzhi, whose courtesy name was Yangshu, was a native of Jianyang in Jian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 舉進士，歷知封州、漢陽軍，入為監察御史、右司諫，改起居舍人、知諫院。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination and successively served as prefect of Feng Prefecture and Han Yang Army. He entered the capital as Investigating Censor and Remonstrator of the Right Bureau, then became Attendant in the Office of Daily Records and Director of the Remonstrance Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination and successively served as prefect of Feng Prefecture and Han Yang Army. He entered the capital as Investigating Censor and Remonstrator of the Right Bureau, then became Attendant in the Office of Daily Records and Director of the Remonstrance Bureau.

sentences.zh: 時俗好藏去交親尺牘，有訟，則轉相告言，有司據以推詰。

translations.literal: It was then customary to hide away letters from relatives and friends. When lawsuits arose, people would inform on one another, and the authorities used this as basis for investigation and interrogation.
translations.idiomatic: It was then customary to hide away letters from relatives and friends. When lawsuits arose, people would inform on one another, and the authorities used such reports as grounds for investigation and interrogation.

sentences.zh: 升之謂：「此告訐之習也，請禁止之。」

translations.literal: Shengzhi said: "This is the habit of informing and impeaching; I ask that it be forbidden."
translations.idiomatic: Shengzhi said, "This is the habit of informing and impeaching. I ask that it be forbidden."

sentences.zh: 又言：「三館為搢紳華途，近者用人益輕，遂為貴遊進取之階，請嚴其選。」

translations.literal: He also said: "The Three Halls are the splendid path of the gentry. Recently appointments have grown ever lighter, until they have become a ladder for the privileged to advance. I ask that selection be made strict."
translations.idiomatic: He also said, "The Three Halls are the splendid path of the gentry. Recently appointments have grown ever lighter, until they have become a ladder for the privileged to advance. I ask that selection be made strict."

sentences.zh: 詔自今臣僚乞子孫恩者，毋得除館閣。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that from then on, when officials petitioned for favors for their descendants, they might not be appointed to Hall posts.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that from then on, when officials petitioned for favors for their descendants, they might not be appointed to Hall posts.

sentences.zh: 著作佐郎王瓘遇殿帥郭承祐於道，訶怒不下馬，執送府。

translations.literal: Associate Compiler Wang Guan encountered Palace Guard Commander Guo Chengyou on the road, berated him angrily for not dismounting, and had him seized and sent to the prefectural office.
translations.idiomatic: Associate Compiler Wang Guan encountered Palace Guard Commander Guo Chengyou on the road, berated him angrily for not dismounting, and had him seized and sent to the prefectural office.

sentences.zh: 升之言京官不宜為節度使下馬，因劾承祐驕恣，解其任。

translations.literal: Shengzhi said that capital officials should not dismount for military commissioners. He impeached Chengyou for arrogance and insubordination and had him removed from office.
translations.idiomatic: Shengzhi said that capital officials should not dismount for military commissioners. He impeached Chengyou for arrogance and insubordination and had him removed from office.

sentences.zh: 張堯佐緣後宮親，為三司使，尋為宣徽使；

translations.literal: Zhang Yaozuo, through connections to the inner palace, became Commissioner of the Three Departments, then Commissioner of Palace Attendants;
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yaozuo, through connections to the inner palace, became Commissioner of the Three Departments and then Commissioner of Palace Attendants;

sentences.zh: 內侍王守忠領兩鎮留後，求升正班；

translations.literal: eunuch Wang Shouzhong held military commissioner posts in two circuits and sought promotion to regular rank;
translations.idiomatic: the eunuch Wang Shouzhong held military commissioner posts in two circuits and sought promotion to regular rank;

sentences.zh: 御史張昪補郡，久不召；

translations.literal: Censor Zhang Bian was assigned to a prefecture and long not summoned;
translations.idiomatic: Censor Zhang Bian was assigned to a prefecture and for a long time was not summoned back;

sentences.zh: 彭思永論事，令窮問所從來；

translations.literal: Peng Siyong criticized affairs and was ordered harshly questioned on his sources;
translations.idiomatic: Peng Siyong criticized affairs and was ordered harshly questioned as to his sources;

sentences.zh: 唐介擊宰相，斥嶺南：升之皆極諫。

translations.literal: Tang Jie attacked the chief councillor and was banished to Lingnan: Shengzhi remonstrated forcefully in all these cases.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Jie attacked the chief councillor and was banished to Lingnan—in all these cases Shengzhi remonstrated forcefully.

sentences.zh: 遷侍御史知雜事。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Attending Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Attending Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 凡任言責五年，所上數十百事，然持論不堅，以故不盡施用。

translations.literal: In all he held remonstrance duties for five years and submitted several dozen to a hundred items, but his arguments were not firm, and for that reason not all were implemented.
translations.idiomatic: In all he held remonstrance duties for five years and submitted several dozen to a hundred memorials, but his arguments were not firm, and for that reason not all were implemented.

sentences.zh: 擢天章閣待制、河北都轉運使，知瀛州、真定府，加龍圖閣直學士，復知諫院。

translations.literal: Promoted to Academician Awaiting Orders at the Hall of Heavenly Manifestations and Chief Fiscal Commissioner of Hebei, prefect of Ying and Zhending, added Academician Directly Attached to the Hall of Dragon Diagrams, and again made Director of the Remonstrance Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Academician Awaiting Orders at the Hall of Heavenly Manifestations and Chief Fiscal Commissioner of Hebei, served as prefect of Ying and Zhending, was given the additional title of Academician Directly Attached to the Hall of Dragon Diagrams, and again made Director of the Remonstrance Bureau.

sentences.zh: 上言：「天下州縣治否，朝廷不能周知，悉付之轉運使。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "Whether prefectures and counties throughout the realm are well governed, the court cannot know in full detail, and all is entrusted to the fiscal commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized, "Whether prefectures and counties throughout the realm are well governed, the court cannot know in full detail, and all is entrusted to the fiscal commissioners.

sentences.zh: 今選用不精，又無考課，非闇滯罷懦，則淩肆刻薄，所以疾苦愁歎，雍圩上聞。

translations.literal: Selection is now careless, and there is no performance review. They are either dim-witted, stagnant, dismissed, and cowardly, or overbearing, wanton, and harshly petty. Hence suffering, grief, and sighs are blocked from reaching the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Appointments are now made carelessly, and there is no performance review. The commissioners are either dim-witted, stagnant, dismissed, and cowardly, or overbearing, wanton, and harshly petty. Hence the people's suffering and grief are blocked from reaching the throne.

sentences.zh: 必欲垂意元元，宜從此始。」

translations.literal: If Your Majesty truly wishes to care for the common people, this is where to begin."
translations.idiomatic: If Your Majesty truly wishes to care for the common people, this is where to begin."

sentences.zh: 乃詔翰林學士承旨孫抃、權御史中丞張昪，與升之同領磨勘轉運使及提點刑獄功務。

translations.literal: An edict then ordered Hanlin Academician Exemplar Sun Bian, Acting Vice Censor-in-Chief Zhang Bian, and Shengzhi jointly to conduct merit review of fiscal commissioners and legal intendant work.
translations.idiomatic: An edict then ordered Hanlin Academician Exemplar Sun Bian, Acting Vice Censor-in-Chief Zhang Bian, and Shengzhi jointly to conduct merit review of fiscal commissioners and legal intendant work.

sentences.zh: 升之初為諫官時，嘗請抑絕內降，詔許有司執奏勿下。

translations.literal: When Shengzhi first served as remonstrator, he had asked to restrain inner-palace direct appointments. An edict permitted the relevant offices to hold them and memorialize, and not implement them.
translations.idiomatic: When Shengzhi first served as remonstrator, he had asked to restrain inner-palace direct appointments. An edict permitted the relevant offices to hold such orders and memorialize against them rather than implement them.

sentences.zh: 至是，申言之。

translations.literal: At this time he stated it again.
translations.idiomatic: At this time he stated the matter again.

sentences.zh: 詔委三省劾正其罪，仍揭於朝堂。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Three Departments to investigate and correct the offenses, and the results were posted in the court hall.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Three Departments to investigate and correct the offenses, and the results were posted in the court hall.

sentences.zh: 文彥博乞罷相，升之慮樞密使賈昌朝復用，疏論其邪，昌朝卒罷去。

translations.literal: Wen Yanbo asked to resign as chief councillor. Shengzhi feared that Bureau of Military Affairs Commissioner Jia Changchao would be used again. He submitted a memorial arguing Changchao's wickedness, and Changchao was finally dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Yanbo asked to resign as chief councillor. Shengzhi feared that Bureau of Military Affairs Commissioner Jia Changchao would be restored to office. He submitted a memorial arguing Changchao's wickedness, and Changchao was finally dismissed.

sentences.zh: 遷樞密直學士、知開封府。

translations.literal: Transferred to Academician Directly Attached to the Bureau of Military Affairs and prefect of Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Academician Directly Attached to the Bureau of Military Affairs and prefect of Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 歲餘，拜樞密副使。

translations.literal: After a little over a year, appointed Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: After a little over a year, he was appointed Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 於是諫官御史唐介、范師道、呂誨、趙抃、王陶交章論升之陰結宦者，故得大用。

translations.literal: Thereupon remonstrators and censors Tang Jie, Fan Shidao, Lü Hui, Zhao Bian, and Wang Tao submitted successive memorials arguing that Shengzhi had secretly allied with eunuchs and therefore gained great employment.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon remonstrators and censors Tang Jie, Fan Shidao, Lü Hui, Zhao Bian, and Wang Tao submitted successive memorials arguing that Shengzhi had secretly allied with eunuchs and therefore gained high office.

sentences.zh: 仁宗以示升之，升之丐去。

translations.literal: Emperor Renzong showed this to Shengzhi, and Shengzhi begged to leave.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Renzong showed this to Shengzhi, and Shengzhi begged to leave office.

sentences.zh: 帝謂輔臣曰：「朕選用執政，豈容內臣預議邪。」

translations.literal: The emperor said to his ministers: "When I select men for high office, how can I tolerate inner officials participating in the deliberation?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said to his ministers, "When I select men for high office, how can I tolerate inner officials participating in the deliberation?"

sentences.zh: 乃兩罷之。

translations.literal: Thereupon both were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon both were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 以升之為資政殿學士、知定州，徙太原府。

translations.literal: Shengzhi was made Grand Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance and prefect of Dingzhou, then transferred to Taiyuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Shengzhi was made Grand Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance and prefect of Dingzhou, then transferred to Taiyuan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 治平二年，復拜樞密副使。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhiping he was again appointed Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhiping he was again appointed Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 神宗立，以母老請郡，為觀文殿學士、知越州。

translations.literal: When Emperor Shenzong ascended, he asked for a prefectural post because his mother was old. He was made Grand Academician of the Hall for Observing Culture and prefect of Yue Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Shenzong ascended the throne, he asked for a prefectural post because his mother was old. He was made Grand Academician of the Hall for Observing Culture and prefect of Yue Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 熙甯元年，徙許，中道改大名府，過闕，留知樞密院。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xining he was transferred to Xu, en route changed to Daming Prefecture. Passing the capital, he was kept on as Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xining he was transferred to Xu, but en route his appointment was changed to Daming Prefecture. Passing the capital, he was kept on as Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 故事，樞密使與知院事不並置。

translations.literal: By precedent, the Bureau Commissioner and the Director of the Bureau were not both appointed at once.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent, the Bureau Commissioner and the Director of the Bureau were not both appointed at once.

sentences.zh: 時文彥博、呂公著既為使，帝以升之三輔政，欲稍異其禮，故特命之。

translations.literal: At the time Wen Yanbo and Lü Gongzhu were already commissioners. The emperor, because Shengzhi had served as one of three chief ministers, wished to mark his status slightly differently, and so specially appointed him.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Wen Yanbo and Lü Gongzhu were already commissioners. Because Shengzhi had served as one of three chief ministers, the emperor wished to mark his status slightly differently and so specially appointed him.

sentences.zh: 明年，同制置三司條例司，與王安石共事。

translations.literal: The next year he jointly established the Fiscal Reform Commission and worked with Wang Anshi.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he jointly established the Fiscal Reform Commission and worked with Wang Anshi.

sentences.zh: 數月，拜中書門下平章事、集賢殿大學士。

translations.literal: Within several months he was appointed Grand Councillor of the Secretariat-Chancellery and Grand Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: Within several months he was appointed Grand Councillor of the Secretariat-Chancellery and Grand Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies.

sentences.zh: 升之既相，遂請免條例司，其說以為宰相無所不統，所領職事，豈可稱司。

translations.literal: Once Shengzhi became chief councillor, he asked to abolish the Fiscal Reform Commission. His argument was that the chief councillor oversees everything and the duties he heads cannot be called a "commission."
translations.idiomatic: Once Shengzhi became chief councillor, he asked to abolish the Fiscal Reform Commission. His argument was that the chief councillor oversees everything and the duties he heads cannot be called a "commission."

sentences.zh: 安石曰：「古之六卿，即今之執政，有司馬、司徒、司空，各名一職，何害於理？」

translations.literal: Wang Anshi said: "The Six Ministers of antiquity were today's chief ministers—there were the Minister of War, Minister of Education, and Minister of Works, each named for a duty. What harm is there in principle?"
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi said, "The Six Ministers of antiquity were today's chief ministers—there were the Minister of War, Minister of Education, and Minister of Works, each named for a duty. What harm is there in principle?"

sentences.zh: 升之曰：「若制置百司條例則可，但今制置三司一官，則不可。」

translations.literal: Shengzhi said: "If it were establishing regulations for the hundred offices, that would be acceptable. But establishing regulations for a single Three Departments office cannot be done."
translations.idiomatic: Shengzhi said, "If it were establishing regulations for the hundred offices, that would be acceptable. But establishing regulations for a single Three Departments office cannot be done."

sentences.zh: 由是忤安石，稱疾歸臥逾十旬，帝數敦諭，乃出。

translations.literal: Thereby he offended Wang Anshi. He claimed illness and retired to bed for more than a hundred days. The emperor repeatedly urged him earnestly, and only then did he emerge.
translations.idiomatic: Thereby he offended Wang Anshi. He claimed illness and retired to bed for more than a hundred days. The emperor repeatedly urged him earnestly, and only then did he emerge.

sentences.zh: 會母喪，去位；

translations.literal: When his mother died he left office;
translations.idiomatic: When his mother died he left office.

sentences.zh: 終制，召為樞密使。

translations.literal: When mourning ended he was summoned as Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended he was summoned as Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 足疾不能立朝，七年，冬祀，又不能相禮。

translations.literal: Foot ailment prevented him from standing at court. In the seventh year, at the winter sacrifice, he could not again assist in the rites.
translations.idiomatic: A foot ailment prevented him from standing at court. In the seventh year, at the winter sacrifice, he could not again assist in the rites.

sentences.zh: 拜鎮江軍節度使、同平章事、判揚州，封秀國公。

translations.literal: Appointed Military Commissioner of Zhenjiang Army, Concurrent Grand Councillor, and Administrator of Yangzhou. Enfeoffed as Duke of Xiuguo.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Military Commissioner of Zhenjiang Army, Concurrent Grand Councillor, and Administrator of Yangzhou, and enfeoffed as Duke of Xiuguo.

sentences.zh: 卒，年六十九。

translations.literal: He died, aged sixty-nine.
translations.idiomatic: He died, aged sixty-nine.

sentences.zh: 贈太保、中書令，諡曰成肅。

translations.literal: Posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Preceptor and Director of the Chancellery; posthumous title Chengsu.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Preceptor and Director of the Chancellery, with the posthumous title Chengsu.

sentences.zh: 升之深狡多數，善傅會以取富貴。

translations.literal: Shengzhi was deeply cunning and scheming, skilled at twisting circumstances to gain wealth and rank.
translations.idiomatic: Shengzhi was deeply cunning and scheming, skilled at twisting circumstances to win wealth and rank.

sentences.zh: 王安石用事，患正論盈庭，引升之自助。

translations.literal: When Wang Anshi held power, troubled that upright discourse filled the court, he brought in Shengzhi to assist himself.
translations.idiomatic: When Wang Anshi held power, troubled that upright discourse filled the court, he brought in Shengzhi to assist him.

sentences.zh: 升之心知其不可，而竭力為之用，安石德之，故使先己為相。

translations.literal: Shengzhi knew in his heart it was wrong, yet exerted himself on Anshi's behalf. Anshi was grateful and therefore had him serve as chief councillor before himself.
translations.idiomatic: Shengzhi knew in his heart it was wrong, yet exerted himself on Anshi's behalf. Anshi was grateful and therefore had him serve as chief councillor before taking the post himself.

sentences.zh: 甫得志，即求解條例司，又時為小異，陽若不與之同者。

translations.literal: Hardly had he gained his aim when he asked to be relieved of the Fiscal Reform Commission; he also occasionally offered minor differences, outwardly as if not in agreement.
translations.idiomatic: Hardly had he gained his aim when he asked to be relieved of the Fiscal Reform Commission. He also occasionally offered minor differences, outwardly as if he did not agree.

sentences.zh: 世以是譏之，謂之「筌相」。

translations.literal: The world on this account mocked him, calling him the "Quan Chief Councillor."
translations.idiomatic: People mocked him for this and called him the "Trap Chief Councillor"—after the bamboo fish trap, for feigning to differ from Wang Anshi while in fact serving him.

sentences.zh: 升之初名旭，避神宗嫌名，改焉。

translations.literal: Shengzhi's original personal name was Xu; to avoid the taboo name of Emperor Shenzong, he changed it.
translations.idiomatic: Shengzhi's original personal name was Xu; to avoid the taboo name of Emperor Shenzong, he changed it.

sentences.zh: 吳充，字沖卿，建州浦城人。

translations.literal: Wu Chong, courtesy name Chongqing, was a native of Pucheng in Jian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Chong, whose courtesy name was Chongqing, was a native of Pucheng in Jian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 未冠舉進士，與兄育、京、方皆高第。

translations.literal: Before coming of age he passed the jinshi examination; he and his elder brothers Yu, Jing, and Fang all ranked at the top.
translations.idiomatic: Before coming of age he passed the jinshi examination. He and his elder brothers Yu, Jing, and Fang all ranked at the top.

sentences.zh: 調穀熟主簿，入為國子監直講、吳王宮教授。

translations.literal: Appointed chief clerk of Gushu; entered service as Erudite Lecturer of the Directorate of Education and Instructor at the Prince of Wu's palace.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed chief clerk of Gushu, then entered service as Erudite Lecturer of the Directorate of Education and Instructor at the Prince of Wu's palace.

sentences.zh: 等輩多與宗室狎，充齒最少，獨以嚴見憚，相率設席受經。

translations.literal: His peers mostly were familiar with imperial clansmen; Chong was youngest in age but alone was feared for his severity, and they all in turn set out mats to receive his instruction in the classics.
translations.idiomatic: His peers mostly fraternized with imperial clansmen. Chong was the youngest, yet alone was feared for his severity, and they all in turn set out mats to receive his instruction in the classics.

sentences.zh: 充作《六箴》以獻，曰視，曰聽，曰好，曰學，曰進德，曰崇儉。

translations.literal: Chong composed the "Six Admonitions" and presented them, titled Vision, Hearing, Pleasure, Learning, Advancing in Virtue, and Honoring Frugality.
translations.idiomatic: Chong composed the "Six Admonitions" and presented them, on Vision, Hearing, Pleasure, Learning, Advancing in Virtue, and Honoring Frugality.

sentences.zh: 仁宗命繕寫賜皇族，英宗在藩邸，書之坐右。

translations.literal: Emperor Renzong ordered them copied and bestowed on the imperial clan; when Emperor Yingzong was still in his princely residence, he kept the text at his right hand.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Renzong ordered them copied and bestowed on the imperial clan. When Emperor Yingzong was still in his princely residence, he kept the text at his right hand.

sentences.zh: 英宗立，數問充所在，會入覲，語其為吳王宮教授時事，嘉勞之。

translations.literal: When Yingzong acceded, he repeatedly asked where Chong was; when Chong happened to come for an audience, the emperor spoke of his service as instructor at the Prince of Wu's palace and praised and rewarded him.
translations.idiomatic: When Yingzong acceded, he repeatedly asked where Chong was. When Chong happened to come for an audience, the emperor spoke of his service as instructor at the Prince of Wu's palace and praised and rewarded him.

sentences.zh: 尋權鹽鐵副使。

translations.literal: Soon he served as acting Vice Commissioner of Salt and Iron.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he served as acting Vice Commissioner of Salt and Iron.

sentences.zh: 熙甯元年，知制誥。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xining, he was made Drafting Director.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xining, he was made Drafting Director.

sentences.zh: 神宗諭以任用意，曰：「先帝知卿久矣。」

translations.literal: Emperor Shenzong instructed him to act according to his own judgment, saying: "The late emperor knew you well for a long time."
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shenzong instructed him to act according to his own judgment, saying, "The late emperor knew you well for a long time.

sentences.zh: 遂同知諫院。

translations.literal: He was then made Associate Director of the Remonstrance Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: He was then made Associate Director of the Remonstrance Bureau.

sentences.zh: 言：「士大夫親沒，或藁殯數十年，傷敗風化，宜限期使葬。」

translations.literal: He said: "When scholar-officials' parents die, some leave the corpse in temporary burial for decades—this damages customs; they should be given a deadline for burial."
translations.idiomatic: He said, "When scholar-officials' parents die, some leave the corpse in temporary burial for decades. This damages customs, and they should be given a deadline for burial.

sentences.zh: 詔著為令。

translations.literal: An edict was issued making this a statute.
translations.idiomatic: An edict was issued making this a statute.

sentences.zh: 河北水災、地震，為安撫使。

translations.literal: When Hebei suffered flooding and earthquake, he was made Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: When Hebei suffered flooding and earthquake, he was made Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 使還，王安石參知政事，充子安持，其婿也，引嫌解諫職，知審刑院，權三司使，為翰林學士。

translations.literal: On returning from his mission, Wang Anshi became Vice Grand Councillor; Chong's son Anchi was his son-in-law, so citing conflict of interest he resigned his remonstrance post, became Director of the Office of Review of Judicial Punishments, acting Commissioner of the Three Departments, and Hanlin Academician.
translations.idiomatic: On returning from his mission, Wang Anshi became Vice Grand Councillor. Chong's son Anchi was his son-in-law, so citing conflict of interest he resigned his remonstrance post and became Director of the Office of Review of Judicial Punishments, acting Commissioner of the Three Departments, and Hanlin Academician.

sentences.zh: 三年，拜樞密副使。

translations.literal: In the third year he was appointed Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was appointed Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 王韶取洮州，蕃酋木征遁去，充請招還故地，縻以爵秩，使自領所部，永為外臣，無庸列置郡縣，殫財屈力。

translations.literal: When Wang Shao took Tao Prefecture and the tribal chief Muzheng fled, Chong requested recruiting him back to his former territory, binding him with titles and ranks so he would govern his own followers, remain forever an outer vassal, with no need to establish prefectures and counties—exhausting finances and strength.
translations.idiomatic: When Wang Shao took Tao Prefecture and the tribal chief Muzheng fled, Chong requested recruiting him back to his former territory, binding him with titles and ranks so he would govern his own followers, remain forever an outer vassal, and spare the state the need to establish prefectures and counties at the cost of exhausting finances and strength.

sentences.zh: 時方以開拓付韶，充言不用。

translations.literal: At the time expansion was entrusted to Shao; Chong's proposal was not adopted.
translations.idiomatic: At the time expansion was entrusted to Shao, and Chong's proposal was not adopted.

sentences.zh: 八年，進檢校太傅、樞密使。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was advanced to Acting Grand Tutor and Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was advanced to Acting Grand Tutor and Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 充雖與安石連姻，而心不善其所為，數為帝言政事不便。

translations.literal: Although Chong was related by marriage to Anshi, he disapproved in his heart of what Anshi did and repeatedly told the emperor that government measures were inconvenient.
translations.idiomatic: Although Chong was related by marriage to Anshi, he disapproved in his heart of what Anshi did and repeatedly told the emperor that government measures were inconvenient.

sentences.zh: 帝察其中立無與，欲相之，安石去，遂代為同中書門下平章事、監修國史。

translations.literal: The emperor saw his neutrality and lack of partisanship and wished to make him chief councillor; when Anshi left, he succeeded him as Concurrent Grand Councillor and Supervisor of the National History.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor saw his neutrality and lack of partisanship and wished to make him chief councillor. When Anshi left, he succeeded him as Concurrent Grand Councillor and Supervisor of the National History.

sentences.zh: 充欲有所變革，乞召還司馬光、呂公著、韓維、蘇頌，乃薦孫覺、李常、程顥等數十人。

translations.literal: Chong wished to make reforms and begged to recall Sima Guang, Lü Gongzhu, Han Wei, and Su Song; he also recommended Sun Jue, Li Chang, Cheng Hao, and several dozen others.
translations.idiomatic: Chong wished to make reforms and begged to recall Sima Guang, Lü Gongzhu, Han Wei, and Su Song. He also recommended Sun Jue, Li Chang, Cheng Hao, and several dozen others.

sentences.zh: 光亦以充可告語，與之書曰：「自新法之行，中外洶洶。

translations.literal: Guang also considered Chong someone he could speak to frankly, and wrote him: "Since the new laws have been implemented, alarm has surged inside and outside the court.
translations.idiomatic: Guang also considered Chong someone he could speak to frankly, and wrote him: "Since the new laws have been implemented, alarm has surged inside and outside the court.

sentences.zh: 民困於煩苛，迫於誅斂，愁怨流離，轉死溝壑。

translations.literal: The people are worn down by onerous regulations, pressed by levies and confiscations, grievance and displacement, dying in ditches and gullies.
translations.idiomatic: The people are worn down by onerous regulations, pressed by levies and confiscations, full of grievance and displacement, dying in ditches and gullies.

sentences.zh: 日夜引領，冀朝廷覺悟，一變敝法，幾年於茲矣。

translations.literal: Day and night one stretches one's neck in hope, wishing the court would awaken and overturn the flawed laws—all these years now.
translations.idiomatic: Day and night one stretches one's neck in hope, wishing the court would awaken and overturn the flawed laws—all these years now.

sentences.zh: 今日救天下之急，苟不罷青苗、免役、保甲、市易，息征伐之謀，而欲求成效，猶惡湯之沸，而益薪鼓橐也。

translations.literal: Today to save the realm's urgent peril—if one does not abolish the Green Sprouts, Corvée Exemption, Baojia, and Market Stabilization laws, and quiet plans for campaigns, yet seeks results, it is like hating that soup is boiling yet adding firewood and pumping the bellows.
translations.idiomatic: Today, to save the realm's urgent peril, if one does not abolish the Green Sprouts, Corvée Exemption, Baojia, and Market Stabilization laws and quiet plans for campaigns, yet seeks results, it is like hating that soup is boiling yet adding firewood and pumping the bellows.

sentences.zh: 欲去此五者，必先別利害，以悟人主之心。

translations.literal: To remove these five things, one must first distinguish harm and benefit to awaken the sovereign's heart.
translations.idiomatic: To remove these five things, one must first distinguish harm and benefit to awaken the sovereign's heart.

sentences.zh: 欲悟人主之心，必先開言路。

translations.literal: To awaken the sovereign's heart, one must first open the path of speech.
translations.idiomatic: To awaken the sovereign's heart, one must first open the path of speech.

sentences.zh: 今病雖已深，猶未至膏肓，失今不治，遂為痼疾矣。」

translations.literal: Today's illness is already deep, yet has not reached the vital organ; if it is not treated now, it will become a chronic disease."
translations.idiomatic: Today's illness is already deep, yet has not reached the vital organ. If it is not treated now, it will become a chronic disease.

sentences.zh: 充不能用。

translations.literal: Chong could not adopt it.
translations.idiomatic: Chong could not adopt it.

sentences.zh: 王珪與充並相，忌充，陰掣其肘。

translations.literal: Wang Gui served as chief councillor alongside Chong, envied him, and secretly held him back.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Gui served as chief councillor alongside Chong, envied him, and secretly held him back.

sentences.zh: 而充素惡蔡確，確治相州獄，捕安持及親戚、官屬考治，欲鉤致充語，帝獨明其亡他。

translations.literal: Chong had long disliked Cai Que; Que investigated the Xiangzhou case, arresting Anchi and relatives and staff for interrogation, seeking to hook Chong's words; the emperor alone understood he had no other involvement.
